description: Initial role catalog seed. The implementation must validate this catalog and enforce it against actual paths. It is not a preexisting checker configuration.

style_organization.description: Where a stylesheet lives, which category owns it, and which classes it may style. The rules live here so the checker reads them as data.

categories.purpose: Application shell, stage, navigation chrome and the workspace frame.
The assistant rail, conversation threads, branches and the composer.
Shared workspace surfaces: tabs, search, scrollbars and the destination frame.
The settings surface and its sections.
Knowledge collections, feeds and embedding settings.
Calendar views, import and the automation form.
Market, teams, prompts, apps and glossary surfaces.
Model setup, local AI runtime and provider surfaces.
Tool connections, the tool catalog and the code interpreter.
Workplace media and the arcade stage.
Reusable controls and primitives used by more than one category.
Adapters that talk to the service.
Entry and composition roots, and the stylesheet manifest.

rules.colocated_stylesheets: A stylesheet sits in the same category folder as the component whose classes it styles, and its name matches that component.
rules.single_import: A stylesheet is imported by exactly one manifest, never by a component.
rules.class_ownership: A class prefix is owned by one category. A second category that styles it is an overlap and is reported.
rules.base_owns_defaults: Element resets, focus rings, prose and the shared control families live only in the shared base. A category stylesheet may not redeclare them.
rules.no_flat_pile: A category folder holds the components and stylesheets of one feature, not a miscellaneous pile.
